## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite validator must enforce the twelve-character minimum before merge because the stated security policy applies to passwords set through invitations as well.

## Changes
The pull request raises the signup and reset password minimum from eight to twelve characters and updates their boundary tests. It also adds a standalone review note.

## Critical
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Enforce the twelve-character minimum for invites — An eight-character password still passes invite validation after signup raises its minimum to twelve. The invite validator uses its own eight-character minimum at `app/invite.py:1`. — Users joining by invitation can set passwords below the required minimum. — Fix: Update `app/invite.py:1` and extend `tests/test_invite.py::test_password_boundaries` to cover the new cutoff.
